title.narrative: Renewable energy advocacy and ecosystem development in Cambodia and Laos

description.narrative: The investment provides technical assistance, delivered by the Energy Laboratory Ltd., to support the development of the renewable energy ecosystem and clean energy advocacy in Laos and Cambodia:(1) increase and support government commitments to clean energy, (2) improve technical and economic knowledge among energy actors, and (3) increase stakeholders’ understanding of clean energy acceleration pathways.

title.narrative: Climate adaptation, mitigation, environment and biodiversity

description.narrative: The Cambodia and Laos Renewable Energy Advocacy and Ecosystem Development program promotes clean energy market building and advocacy in both countries. ‍ In Cambodia, the program supported planning for the Cambodia's Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) market by delivering a report on competitive REC models. This contributed to the government’s regulatory process toward adopting REC implementation guidelines. It also advanced the development of the electric vehicle (EV) sector by organising the Electric Vehicle Showcase 2024, facilitating consultations between development partners and the private sector on the EV Policy, and conducting a comprehensive assessment of current skills gaps, opportunities and challenges in the sector. These efforts have contributed to the adoption of the National Policy on the Development of Electric Vehicles 2024-2030. ‍ In Laos, EnergyLab hosted Renewable Energy Day, which enhanced understanding and collaboration across the sector. In Cambodia, EnergyLab also completed research on alternatives to new coal power construction, demonstrating how a mix of solar, wind and hydro could cost-effectively meet Cambodia's needs. These activities have contributed to increased engagement with renewable energy in both countries.

title.narrative: Climate adaptation, mitigation, environment and biodiversity

description.narrative: The Cambodia and Laos Renewable Energy Advocacy and Ecosystem Development program promotes clean energy market-building and advocacy in both countries. In Cambodia, it focuses on creating policy dialogue opportunities through events like Clean Energy Week and developing partnerships with key ministries. These efforts have yielded results: In December 2023, H.E. Keo Rottanak, Minister for Mines and Energy, announced Cambodia's aim to double solar power capacity by 2030, surpassing the 1GW target set in the 2022 Power Development Plan. This commitment demonstrates the program's impact in increasing renewable energy's share in Cambodia's energy mix.
